Heating, ventilation and cooling: - The automatic air conditioning system regulates temperature, airflow and distribution automatically.
- Driver and passenger can adjust temperature independently (dual zone).
- A/C function cools the interior and reduces humidity.
- Air distribution can be directed manually via the touchscreen or control panel.
- Rear passengers may have dedicated air vents and climate controls.
- The system uses sensors to regulate air temperature and sunlight exposure.
- Windshield defrost function activates maximum blower speed and temperature.
- Air recirculation mode blocks external air and can be activated manually or automatically.
- Avoid extended use of recirculation mode to prevent window fogging.
- Fan speed can be adjusted manually.
- The system may operate at reduced power to save energy in certain conditions.
Stationary air conditioning: - Allows pre-heating or pre-cooling of the vehicle when parked.
- Can be activated immediately or programmed for a specific time.
- Uses the high-voltage battery, which must have sufficient charge.
- Activation options include the infotainment system or CUPRA app.
- Departure time scheduling ensures a comfortable temperature at a desired time.
- Recommended to use while the vehicle is connected to a charging station.
- Saves energy during driving by conditioning the cabin in advance.
- May be disabled if battery state of charge is too low.
